name: Omarchy Backup
summary: Full backup and restore for Omarchy to Google Drive

featured.headline: Never lose your Omarchy setup again.
featured.tagline: Back up your dotfiles, configurations, Hermes agent, and installed packages directly to Google Drive or a local disk. Fully encrypted with your own passphrase.

features.title: AES-GCM Encryption
features.body: Your data is locked down with your own passphrase before it ever leaves your machine.

features.title: Google Drive Integration
features.body: Uploads securely to the hidden AppData folder on your Google Drive.

features.title: Local Backups
features.body: Prefer local storage? Instantly save encrypted backups to your secondary drives.

changelog.title: Initial Release
items: One-click backup of ~/.hermes, ~/.config, ~/.bashrc, ~/.zshrc, and pacman packages.
End-to-end AES-GCM encryption with PBKDF2 key derivation.
Direct upload to Google Drive's hidden AppData folder.
GUI for easy backup and restore management.
